dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: What are you doing here? Madame Melo?

dialogues.speaker: Melo Lombroso
dialogues.text: Oh, it's you. I heard that no-good husband of mine has a little spot around here, so I figured I'd drop by and check up on him.

dialogues.speaker: Melo Lombroso
dialogues.text: But look what I've found.

dialogues.speaker: Melo Lombroso
dialogues.text: He actually keeps the photo with him!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Heh, Uncle Rocher cares deeply about you, Madame.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: We've had our suspicions on you, and Uncle Rocher was the sole voice of dissent. He alone assured us that you could never have committed the crime. We were wondering where he found the confidence to stand up to us...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Probably used up every last ounce of masculinity he had in him.

dialogues.speaker: Melo Lombroso
dialogues.text: Oh... Really?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Yeah! And didn't he tell you that he lost your locket in gambling? That's not true. He was merely too ashamed to tell the truth.

dialogues.speaker: Melo Lombroso
dialogues.text: Oh, that? I heard that story a long time ago, but I never believed it.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Eh?

dialogues.speaker: Melo Lombroso
dialogues.text: My husband is many things. He may be timorous, somewhat cowardly, and a bit awkward, but he's also a salt-of-the-earth individual. He could be bamboozled, but he's no degenerate gambler.

dialogues.speaker: Melo Lombroso
dialogues.text: I didn't call him out because I was waiting for him to tell me the truth of his own accord.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Wow, how nice of you. If only we could find him right now...

dialogues.speaker: Melo Lombroso
dialogues.text: (Shush... Look over there! I'm 100% certain that he's hiding in that box.)

dialogues.speaker: Melo Lombroso
dialogues.text: (It's an old habit of his. Whenever we'd get into a tiff, he'd go and hide in the nearest closet. And to think he thought I didn't know.)

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: (Do you want us to fetch him for you?)

dialogues.speaker: Melo Lombroso
dialogues.text: (No need to inconvenience yourself. Let's see how long he can hold out in there.)

dialogues.speaker: Melo Lombroso
dialogues.text: Right, there's one other thing I could use your help with. If you ever run into Curve and Agent Talochard, please tell them the following:

dialogues.speaker: Melo Lombroso
dialogues.text: I've tidied up a few of the rooms, so they're welcome here any time. Of course, the House of Lombroso is also open to the two of you.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #But... {NICKNAME}...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Alright, we get it, Madame.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Okay... then we'll get out of your hair. Paimon does hope Uncle Rocher will come out soon. Have a nice day!

dialogues.speaker: Melo Lombroso
dialogues.text: Thank you. And best wishes to you, too. May you find the answers to all your questions.

dialogues.speaker: Strange Box
dialogues.text: Shhhh!
